notes.title: UPDATE 1.5 IS HERE!!!!!!
notes.content:
CHRISTMAS IN APRIL?...

nope But I do have a pretty Major Update for everyone today introducing:

[h1][u]SAVES[/u][/h1]

That's right enjoy finally taking your time soaking up the warm fireplace, being stuck in the sewer, or using that sweet new double jump also included in this update! (mort's been practicing gymnastics very hard) or quit cold turkey with the Capnophobia setting but in the meantime here are the patch notes

PATCH NOOOOOOTTTTTEEEEESSSS

-fixed geometry in several spots
-fixed an issue preventing players from changing setting in the title screen
-fixed and issue causing extreme zoom when leaving dialogue

NEW ADDITIONS
------------------------------------
-Saves
-Double Jump
-Capnophobia toggle
-Moved a mort to a new location
-album covers and new objects in the room

KNOWN ISSUES
------------------------------------
-some players may find themselves falling through the floor of the sewers due to the aerodynamics of mort and his compacity to go Mach 1 (much more rare)
-some players may also be able to get a peak under the floor when using maggot physics... I think the floor doesn't like mort very much (yes I know this has been sitting here for a hot minute)

OVERGROWN! will be released on steam in June! the steam page is live so what are you waiting for? Wishlist now!

new 2.0 update for this game is still in progress but some of the features were so good I wanted to add them to enjoy right now

that all for now but I hope you enjoy these mid sized update

-Tizby

notes.title: Patch notes for Update 1.2
notes.content:
PATCH NOOOOOOTTTTTEEEEESSSS

-fixed an issue causing the final achievement not to be rewarded 
-fixed an issue preventing players from changing setting in the title screen
-fixed and issue causing extreme zoom when leaving dialogue

NEW ADDITIONS
------------------------------------
-Moved the secret mort to an even secreter location
-Added a star on top of the tree!!!

KNOWN ISSUES
------------------------------------
-some players may find themselves falling through the floor of the sewers due to the aerodynamics of mort and his compacity to go Mach 1
-some players may also be able to get a peak under the floor when using maggot physics... I think the floor doesn't like mort very much

I have a fix for both of these issue but its going to take a hot minute to implement them I also have been hard at work on other projects that I'm super excited to announce! At GDC me and couple of other people got to showcase a game called OVERGROWN! and it will be released on steam in June! the steam page is live so what are you waiting for? [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3670500/Overgrown/?beta=0]Wishlist now![/url]

Don't think that all my time has been spent with overgrown though... I have been working hard on the new 2.0 update for this game and while i cant reveal much I can say that Mort will finally be able to express himself while singing! 

that all for now but I hope you enjoy these small quality of life improvements

-Tizby

notes.title: THE GAME IS LIVE!!!!!
notes.content:
[h1][b]MORT IS SET TO BEGIN HIS POST CHRISTMAS JOURNEY![/b][/h1]

after a few... less than stellar website breaking bugs... (shout out to john steam for fixing the buy button) its up! this is my first ever game published to please report any bug you find on the community board and ill try and check back as often as I can.

Ill also be working on a new game in January so ill be updating this game until that point!
